source.text: The volume-mean fuel temperature of the one slice the case holds (slice-2, 0.25 to 0.5 m of the source's frame, set by a heating transfer): the closed-form fuel surface 777.7377 K plus half of the centre-to-surface rise 530.5165 K (the solid cylinder's parabola) = 1042.996 K. The tolerance is the mesh bound of the peak entries, 5 x rise / 100^2 rounded up to 0.05 K (0.3 K), fixed before any run.
source.check: Second method: FEED's closed form integrated over the fuel cross-section (tests/seedFuelTemperature.test.ts) and the real solver (FEED_SOLVER=1, tests/seedOracleStack.test.ts): the solver's cell-weighted mean is inside the tolerance.
